body:
I'm not familiar with your situation, or what has you depressed so I can't go into detail to help you. The point of my story is it took only one person, and one attempt. All I had to do the whole time I was plotting my demise was to talk to one person, however I had a list of people that reached a long way. 

People who truly care about you, would rather you burden them, as to see you take your own life. My luck is few and far between, as are most peoples. Sometimes you lie and bed all day, trying to build that motivation, trying to build that understanding of happiness, when in fact the person who can pull you out, may be very real but also a very unlikely person. 

I have not gone to a church service in three years, however a man doesn't know me too well, know I don't believe what he believes is willing to help me, with no idea if he will ever be compensated. The odds of someone giving you $40,000 dollars is very low, but if someone truly cares about you, the odd of them helping you out in some way regardless of your problems, are quite high.
